comment: Upstream Pi packages the setup offers, exact-pinned like the mise manifest: npm packages use an exact version and Git packages use an exact commit. Users get new versions only when a pin change lands on main; Renovate proposes npm bumps and the catalog-autofix workflow regenerates the embedded catalog. First-party packages still live in plugins/ workspaces.

packages.name: i-have-adhd
packages.label: i-have-adhd
packages.description: ADHD-friendly output for Pi with a session mode toggle, status indicator, and restoration after compaction. By Ayoub G.
packages.nextAction: Run /reload in Pi, then /i-have-adhd on to enable the mode or /i-have-adhd off to disable it.

packages.name: @dietrichgebert/ponytail
packages.label: ponytail
packages.description: Ponytail modes and skills for Pi: prefer simple solutions and inject the active mode's instructions each turn. By Dietrich Gebert.
packages.nextAction: Run /reload in Pi, then /ponytail full to activate Ponytail or /ponytail off to disable it.

packages.name: @plannotator/pi-extension
packages.label: plannotator
packages.description: Interactive plan review with annotations, agent-message annotation, and code review in Pi. By backnotprop.
packages.nextAction: Run /reload in Pi, then /plannotator-plan-mode to write and review a plan, or /plannotator-review to review code.

packages.name: @companion-ai/feynman
packages.label: feynman
packages.description: Research-first Pi package with literature search, scientific databases, source-grounded deep research, and research workflows. By Companion AI.
packages.nextAction: Ask Pi to run /deepresearch on a scientific topic.

packages.name: @ff-labs/pi-fff
packages.label: fff
packages.description: FFF-powered fuzzy file and content search with frecency ranking, git-aware results, and fast @-mention autocomplete. By dmtrKovalenko.
packages.nextAction: Run /reload in Pi, then /fff-health to inspect the index.

packages.name: pi-autoresearch
packages.label: autoresearch
packages.description: Run autonomous optimization loops: change code, benchmark it, keep improvements, and revert regressions. By davebcn87.
packages.nextAction: Run /autoresearch with an optimization target in Pi.

packages.name: pi-mcp-adapter
packages.label: mcp-adapter
packages.description: Connect Pi to MCP servers with lazy connections, cached metadata, and a compact proxy tool to limit context use. By nicobailon.
packages.nextAction: Run /mcp setup in Pi to configure an MCP server.

packages.name: pi-markdown-preview
packages.label: markdown-preview
packages.description: Preview Pi responses and local Markdown, LaTeX, code, and diffs in the terminal, browser, or as PDF. By Oliver Maclaren.
packages.nextAction: Install Pandoc and a Chromium-based browser, run /reload in Pi, then use /preview.

packages.name: pi-subagents
packages.label: subagents
packages.description: Delegate tasks to subagents: chain them, run them in parallel, let them ask you questions mid-run. By nicobailon.
packages.nextAction: Ask Pi to delegate a task to a subagent.

packages.name: pi-web-access
packages.label: web-access
packages.description: web_search and fetch_content tools for pages, PDFs, and GitHub repos. By nicobailon.
packages.nextAction: Ask Pi to search the web.

packages.name: pi-rewind-hook
packages.label: rewind
packages.description: Records file checkpoints as you work; branch to an earlier message and it restores your files to match. By nicobailon.
packages.nextAction: Branch to an earlier Pi message to see files rewind.

packages.name: @gotgenes/pi-anthropic-auth
packages.label: anthropic-auth
packages.description: Use Claude models inside Pi through your Claude subscription, over Anthropic OAuth. By gotgenes.
packages.nextAction: Run /model in Pi and pick a Claude model.
